control.note: Accepted P0 estimator restricted to the BGc target redshift range.

bgc.holdout_policy: Assign target holdout first; exclude every held-out raw target row from the median reference pool.
bgc.nearby_policy: Rows below 1500 km/s are reference-only and never enter the Gaussian BGc likelihood.

external_local_sheet_gate.role: This is a separately labelled observer-environment gate, not a peculiar-velocity calibration statistic.

policy.bgc_statistical_adoption: Both estimators and all numerical gates must pass; cross-estimator log densities are not compared because their transformed observables and variances differ.
policy.N192_and_P2_authorization: Statistical adoption plus the external Local-Sheet gate are required. If calibration passes but the Local-Sheet gate fails, retain BGc only as the distant-row correction and develop a hierarchical likelihood below 1500 km/s before another P2 run.
